content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Tom Warner <tomcando@gmail.com>
Sent: Tuesday, December 22, 2015 8:14 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Marketing the 2016 Tigers 
 
Mr. Fenech,

I have been a Tiger fan for about 40 years and until now have never written to a newspaper. I usually enjoy your Tiger commentary in the Free Press but your story last Sunday was just too biased to swallow. You neglected to mention any of the public comments made by Mr. Illitch that he wants the best players available and that contract money is no problem (even paying the luxury tax could be worked out).

Your article raves about Al Avila’s success in signing a new Tiger’s starting pitcher who last year had a poor 6 and 11 record and then also his signing of a half dozen other second string players.  Add them to the half dozen minor leaguers we got for our three premier free agents at the end of last season and the Toledo Mudhens should be in good shape next year. Well done Al.

You did mention that the Tigers will be rolling the dice with several players contending for the left field job. What you didn't mention is that not any one of them could even carry Cespedes's lunch let alone be a top player.

Now that the Tigers have passed on all of the quality free agents, the fans can look forward to another losing season under the tutelage of Brad Ausmuss, who we can count on to continue making rookie mistakes during his third year on the job. If we are lucky, perhaps Dave Dombrowski will hire Al & Brad to run the Red Sox farm club and Mr. Illitch can then get serious about bringing the fans a winner again.
Enough of the double talk, the fans deserve straight answers.
